page.layout: One printed title page, rotated on the scan: a block of text runs vertically across the upper right of the sheet. No other printed text. The library stamp at the right edge is left out.
page.notes: The page is turned about ninety degrees and the print is very faint, with heavy foxing and staining. The title lines can be partly made out at the upper right, but I cannot read them letter by letter, so each line is marked illegible rather than guessed. The oval RPJCB stamp is a library stamp and is not transcribed.
